title: Kanna Laddu Thinna Aasaiya
desc: Shiva and his friends fall for Soumya, a beautiful woman who recently moved into their locality. The three friends start competing with one another to win her affections.

title: Mr. Bharath
desc: A businessman abandons his first love, to marry a rich heiress. However, things take a turn when his illegitimate son seeks revenge for the injustice done to his mother.

title: Dhil
desc: Kanagavel, an aspiring police officer, beats up a man for misbehaving with his girlfriend. That man turns out to be a corrupt police officer who later starts harassing Kanagavel and his family.

title: Padikathavan
desc: Rocky's father looks down upon him for spending most of his time in a mechanic shop. Soon, his love for Gayathri causes problems.

title: Naan Mirugamai Mara
desc: Bhoominathan seeks revenge after his brother gets murdered. So, he hires some contract killers but soon realises that his family's safety is on the line.
